source_metadata.title: Vitamin K prophylaxis in newborns
source_metadata.author: Sophie Jullien
source_metadata.source_type: narrative evidence review / evidence synthesis for WHO preventive-intervention work

duplicate_review.method: deterministic atom_id from page, kind, and canonical statement; manual review for repeated claims

consistency_findings.detail: The abstract says the literature search ran through 10 December 2019, while the body reports a selected-source search on 10 June 2019 and a PubMed search on 28 June 2019. The extraction preserves both statements without reconciling them.

schema_gaps: LiteratureAtom is designed for primary literature, but this source is a secondary evidence review.
The schema has no dedicated guideline_recommendation kind. Recommendation summaries are stored as atom_kind=other with guideline_recommendation and secondary_reported_recommendation tags.

Trial and surveillance effect estimates are represented as secondary reports anchored to this review, not as primary-study findings. They should be re-extracted from cited primary sources before reuse as primary evidence.
extraction_limitations: Pure bibliography entries were not atomized.
Table 4 guideline recommendations were sampled at the major issuing-body level rather than converting every sentence into a separate atom.
Table 5 country surveillance rows are summarized in SEA and only the principal comparative surveillance claims were atomized.
No supplementary file was bundled with the retrieved PDF.
